title: Failed Apply drains requests and retains acknowledged writes for Undo
steps: Run the fault-injecting live writer tests.
expect: A read refusal stops scheduling and drains delayed parallel siblings before saving the partial result.
A blocked batch retains earlier acknowledged writes and their Undo snapshots.
All changeset items are accounted for as written, failed or skipped.

tests: a stopped parallel Apply drains acknowledged siblings and preserves a complete undoable partial result
a blocked batch retains earlier writes in the failed Apply answer and Undo
